title: Quantifying Effective Heterodyne Detection Efficiency with SI-Traceable Standards
summary: Accurate calibration of coherent optical receivers is essential for reliable performance assessment in coherent communications, precision and quantum sensing, and continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CV-QKD), where the effective detection efficiency directly impacts channel parameter estimation. We present a methodology traceable to the International System of Units (SI) to determine the effective heterodyne detection efficiency of balanced receivers using shot-noise-referenced measurements.
